description:
A quick mid-week video for you as I wasn't happy with the last mango gelato. 
This one is SUPER GOOD, its low fat, super texture, good overrun and tastes amazing. 
I would definitely make this one over the last one. 

What you'll need:

400g Mango Flesh
215g Milk
170g Cream  + 50g added just before churning 
80g Sugar
71g Dextrose
65g SMP
4g Stabilizer blend

------------------------------

Want to make Orange ice cream? Check out this video:
https://youtu.be/Rr-5QuzHejc?si=eoF70vFNG_OKRa1N

--------------------------

Want to make amazing Häagen Dazs Strawberry ice cream? Check out this video:
https://youtu.be/yZYA9L8bTFg?si=Exvh0BDj7JbOCY9w

--------------------------
